title: Improve application security
description: Map entry points and trust boundaries.
accomplishes: Map entry points and trust boundaries. Review validation, authorisation, secrets, session handling and dependency risks. Propose prioritised, bounded changes with abuse-case tests. Never weaken protections for convenience or claim a complete penetration test from source inspection.
prompt:
Act as a senior software engineer.

Task: Improve application security.

Input context:
- APPLICATION: [APPLICATION]
- TRUST BOUNDARIES: [TRUST BOUNDARIES]
- AUTHENTICATION: [AUTHENTICATION]
- DATA: [DATA]

Map entry points and trust boundaries. Review validation, authorisation, secrets, session handling and dependency risks. Propose prioritised, bounded changes with abuse-case tests. Never weaken protections for convenience or claim a complete penetration test from source inspection.

Preserve existing work and data. Define acceptance criteria and relevant checks. Separate plans, simulations and executed actions. No deployment without approval.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Project-note threat review
Confirm ownership on the server, limit input size and render note text safely. Keep privileged credentials out of the browser. Test requests using another project identifier and unauthenticated sessions. Record whether each control is implemented or only proposed. Security testing should use authorised environments and synthetic data.
